title.narrative: Facilitate inclusive, sustained, community-led engagement in Jowhar, and provide technical support on the same to CE partners in Baidoa, Jamaame, and Afmadow.

description.narrative: ltpgtThis project aims to facilitate inclusive, sustained, community-led engagement in Jowhar, and to provide technical support on the same to CE partners in Baidoa, Jamaame, and Afmadow to develop and prioritize Community Engagement Plans (CEPs), sustain community engagement throughout their implementation, and generate learning for locally-led humanitarian programming.lt/pgtltpgtThe project will be implemented by ASEP (Action for Social and Economic Progress), a local NGO specializing in community engagement, in partnership with GTS (Ground Truth Solutions), an INGO that generates research and evidence on community perceptions to improve humanitarian accountability. ASEP will lead implementation through direct community engagement, capacity strengthening, and technical support to CE partners, while GTS will support the learning component by co-facilitating analysis learning sessions and producing learning briefs informed by insights from community engagement and its ongoing research in the project districts.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe project begins with a three-day inception, co-design, and training workshop to build a shared foundation on CE principles and methodologies across the four districts. This is followed by initial community engagement in Jowhar to facilitate communities to develop their action plans/CEPs. ltbrgtMonthly community engagement during implementation, followed by quarterly analysis and learning sessions, will support community-led monitoring of project progress and adaptive actions, strengthen trust and the community engagement mechanism between communities and ABCs, and enable deeper learning on community dynamics to inform humanitarian practice. The process will culminate in a joint end-of-project reflection workshop, to reflect, consolidate lessons and inform future Flagship programming.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtSeparately, ASEP will provide technical support to CE partners in Baidoa, Jamaame, and Afmadow districts through training on the agreed methodology, field-based mentoring, and periodic reflection analysis and learning sessions to refine community engagement skills. lt/pgtltpgtOverall, the project strengthens inclusive, community-led engagement and accountability mechanisms across four districts to ensure communities actively shape, monitor, and inform humanitarian action.ltbrgtlt/pgt
